reviews.title: Need more room and free episodes
reviews.text: Not to happy that I had to switch to a different comics apps to this one that won’t let you start the free episodes from where I want

reviews.title: Screenshots have been Removed
reviews.text: Why must we all be punished for wanting to memorialize our favorite moments as our screensavers and what not. This is highly unfair as it is content we paid for, yet for us who just simply wish to enjoy the pictures we save as wallpapers, we are no longer allowed to do so. As a long time Tappy Toon member since the app was first established, I must say I am highly disappointed. All the memories, and moments I will no longer be able to capture for my own enjoyment has all gone to waste now.

reviews.title: Blocking screenshots & app is unusable
reviews.text: Blocking screenshots is… a choice. Considering most of your revenue comes from people sharing previews of stories which helps get people to the paid platforms. But after the recent update, the app doesn’t even open. Going to be cancelling my monthly subscription until both are fixed.

reviews.title: Unacceptable
reviews.text: Celebrating the 10th anniversary by blocking screenshotting is ridiculous. I literally just want a cute panel of my favorite couple as my screensaver after paying to read a chapter and I can’t even do that anymore. I’m done, never paying for another chapter again.

reviews.title: Horrible staff
reviews.text:
Compared to other platforms this one is nothing special. There’s more uncensored and adult titles offered on the big L. There’s lots of stories on this platform with paltry excuses for translations with errors and ugly formatting. If you raise any kind of issue be it technical or otherwise customer service has an attitude and will
never help you. Expect to have them run around the issue, waste your time an then mock you after all is said and done these people don’t know how to run a company. Spend your money elsewhere.

reviews.title: Endless money pit
reviews.text: If you pay 4.99 for a monthly subscription, you can’t even read more than three chapters. I paid over $20 just to read 75 chapters of a book that’s not even over it says read the rest of the series but they’re still writing it. So far I’ve only been able to read two books that aren’t even completed. I’ve probably spent $30-$40 and I’m now four chapters into another book that I can’t read anymore because I  don’t wanna pay anymore. Don’t download don’t purchase anything. It’s an awful scam.
